text.title: FreshDrop, September 2026 orders, gross margin as revenue
text.criteria_a: weekly buyers with 2+ orders a month in 3–4 categories, almost never contact support
text.strategy_a: priority courier slots, referral bonus, features for their requests
text.criteria_b: buy 2–3 times a month, pay for delivery, but leave when the slot is late
text.strategy_b: fix slot reliability, lower the free delivery threshold
text.criteria_c: one-off orders of 1–2 items, small check, long chats about refunds
text.strategy_c: automate refunds and chat replies, promo by email only
text.criteria_d: sign up for the free promo, leave after the first box, never pay for delivery
text.criteria_x: Moscow families with children, ready to pay for a weekly box but need a bulk-size product
text.strategy_x: test a family box with a 2-week pilot before building it
text.decision: focus on segments A and D; test a cheaper delivery plan for B; stop paid push to X
